subject: KV-index decommission & completion evidence for FinEdge (prompt outputs / logs)
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@finedge.io>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Remove tenant KV-index + prompt output artifacts (FinEdge)

Hi Soojin,

We need Redwood to execute a full decommission of the KV-index created for our sandbox tenant (tenant id: fe-sbx-122) and to purge associated prompt outputs, transient logs, and the generation artifacts stored in the region-us bucket. This is part of our decommissioning checklist ahead of a compliance audit next week.

Scope we need cleared:
- KV-index: fe-sbx-122-index (all shards)
- Prompt-output blobs under /finedge/fe-sbx-122/outputs/ (last 36 months)
- Inference logs and temporary KV caches for that tenant

Questions: estimated ETA, proof of deletion we can include in the audit (hash manifest, timestamps), and whether you need any on-call windows from our side. Prefer deletion in the maintenance window on Thu 2026-10-30 between 01:00-05:00 UTC.

Thanks,
Aisha
Aisha Khan
Data Operations Lead | FinEdge
From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@finedge.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Remove tenant KV-index + prompt output artifacts (FinEdge)

Hi Aisha — thanks for the clear scope.

High level plan (internal + customer-facing):
1) Pre-checks (Thu 01:00 UTC): validate tenant id, snapshot of current index metadata, and backstop retention policy.
2) Decommission step (Thu 01:30 UTC): take KV-index offline, stream-delete index shards, and verify KVstore tombstones.
3) Prompt-output sweep (Thu 02:00 UTC): run region-scoped delete jobs against /finedge/fe-sbx-122/outputs/ with multi-pass verification.
4) Logs & caches (Thu 03:15 UTC): expire transient caches and delete inference logs older than retention window for that tenant.
5) Evidence bundle (Thu 04:30 UTC): deliver CSV manifest + signed hash summary + S3 object delete event ids.

We can do the maintenance window you suggested. Rishi (SRE) and Marissa (Customer Ops) are looped in to execute and validate. We will produce a deletion-manifest.csv and an s3-log-hash-summary.txt.

Ask for you: please confirm you’re comfortable with the window and to whom we should send the final manifest (email + secure Drive link). Also confirm whether records need to be redacted for PD/PII beyond standard retention-based removal.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: Remove tenant KV-index + prompt output artifacts (FinEdge)

Soojin / Rishi — pre-checks complete this morning against fe-sbx-122. Notes:
- No pending active sessions for the tenant.
- KV-index fe-sbx-122-index snapshot saved to ephemeral storage (backed up for 48 hours) per policy.
- Two blobs flagged by retention policy as "protected" (legal hold) — Aisha, can you confirm if those are subject to legal hold? If so we'll exclude them and provide the hold evidence set.

Rishi — I'll coordinate the delete job runbook. I attached the operator runbook (kv-index-decom-runbook.pdf) with exact commands and verification checks.

Marissa
Customer Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachments: kv-index-decom-runbook.pdf (PDF, 210 KB)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@finedge.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Oct 2026 04:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Remove tenant KV-index + prompt output artifacts (FinEdge)

On Thu, Oct 30, 2026 at 01:45 AM UTC, Marissa Cole wrote:
> Running deletion pass 1 now — streaming deletes started for index shards and prompt-output prefixes.

Aisha / Soojin — deletion completed at 04:20 UTC. Summary of evidence:
- deletion-manifest-20261030.csv (rows: 8,512 objects deleted)
- s3-log-hash-summary-20261030.txt (SHA256 hashes for deleted objects, manifest verified)
- CloudTrail delete events collected and stored in secure archive for 90 days.

Quick verification: we re-run a list-objects for prefix /finedge/fe-sbx-122/outputs/ and found zero live objects. KV-index shards returned 404 on retrieval. KV cache entries for tenant expired and were evicted per TTL.

Deliverables (attached and shared):
- deletion-manifest-20261030.csv (CSV)
- s3-log-hash-summary-20261030.txt (TXT)
- Drive package: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/finedge-deletion-pack (read-only link)

If you need a signed attestation for the audit, let us know and we can produce a brief letter with timestamps and operator signatures.

—Rishi
SRE, Redwood Inference
Attachments: deletion-manifest-20261030.csv (CSV, 95 KB); s3-log-hash-summary-20261030.txt (TXT, 18 KB)
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@finedge.io>

Subject: Re: Request: Remove tenant KV-index + prompt output artifacts (FinEdge)

Thanks — confirmed receipt of the manifest and hashes. I spot-checked a handful of object ids and hashes; they match. FinEdge confirms there are no additional legal holds. The audit team will accept the Drive package and the CSV as evidence.

A quick request: please include operator initials and the UTC timestamps in the attestation letter (if you can generate it today that would be ideal). We'll mark this item as closed on our side once we receive the attestation.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Aisha Khan
Data Operations Lead, FinEdge
